reference.code: export function keepLast(v:readonly string[]):string[]{const seen=new Set<string>(),r:string[]=[];for(let i=v.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(!seen.has(v[i])){seen.add(v[i]);r.push(v[i])}return r.reverse()}
